title: Source-Aware Transcode Runtime
problem: Nako's transcode stack has safe HLS/remux and stage-aware hardware readiness, but it still lacks source media facts, structured transcode requirements, source-aware pipeline planning, and runtime supervision needed for Jellyfin-class playback.

evidence.summary: Opened the source-aware transcode runtime lane and proposed ADR 0049 for source facts, transcode requirements, source-aware pipeline planning, FFmpeg command boundaries, and runtime supervision.
Added MediaStreamInfo technical facts and ffprobe parsing for codec profile/level, pixel format, bit depth, frame rate, color/HDR, disposition, rotation, and audio layout.
Persisted stream technical facts through media_streams.technical_json for SQLite and PostgreSQL baselines with round-trip coverage.
Added source-aware playback TranscodeRequirement with selected streams, output constraints, subtitle strategy, source facts, and transcode reasons.
Mapped source-aware playback evidence into redaction-safe Public typed decision reports and Admin readiness/support evidence, including runtime metrics in the Admin TypeScript contract.

Added source facts to TranscodePipelineRequest and connected HLS execution policy planning to stored ffprobe streams, with typed fallback/failure reasons for source codec and bit-depth incompatibility.

Split HLS FFmpeg command construction into staged parts for device/input, stream map, filter graph, video encoder, audio encoder, subtitle, and muxer planning, with QSV argument ordering fixed and covered.
Added FFmpeg progress parsing, redaction-safe transcode runtime metrics, SQLite/Postgres runtime_metrics_json persistence, HLS runner capture, and server HLS persistence coverage.
Prepared progressive HLS serving for running segment readiness, one-shot throttled waiting, and stale sibling .ts cleanup without regressing completed segment routes.

Closed the workstream with fresh focused gates, final formatting and diff checks, no blocking review findings, and follow-ons split for adaptive HLS, fMP4, rsmpeg adapter feasibility, and remote workers.

continue_policy.notes: Closed on 2026-05-28 after the source-aware transcode planning and runtime supervision slice landed. Adaptive HLS ladders, fMP4 output, rsmpeg execution adapter replacement, remote transcode workers, and client UI remain follow-ons.
